title: "Chikaroo" - Short original 2D platformer
author: CaffeinatedPenguin0
selftext:
Meet CHICKAROO, a 2D platformer following a small, determined chick on an adventure.

Built from scratch as an homage to classic platformers, it features over 10 stages each introducing unique mechanics and power-ups. The game was designed from my imagination based on a real life plushy, tuned and built in concert with Claude, Codex, and Gemini.

The major technical twist:

Zero image files: Every sprite, enemy, background, and particle effect is drawn procedurally on every frame. 

100% vanilla tech: \~40,000 lines of pure HTML5/JavaScript with no external game engines or libraries.

Procedural audio: Sound effects are generated in real time via the Web Audio API, accompanied by a soundtrack created with Google Lyria.

It runs instantly in your browser with zero installs. Touch controls and keyboard are fully supported, but for the best experience, plugging in a gamepad is HIGHLY HIGHLY recommended (on PC or mobile).

Enjoy the ride!

👉 Play here: https://rgjp.github.io/v/chickaroo/
